ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, officers, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) against the national list of PEPs published by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), the consolidated UN Security Council Sanctions List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List), the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) consolidated list. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is legally required where a UBO or indirect shareholder holds a public position with a senior political role, or where the country of origin of the beneficial owner appears on the FATF 'grey list' or is identified as a high-risk third country under EU Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1675. In addition, the effective AML/CFT compliance framework must include a written risk-based assessment (Evaluación de Riesgo) and, where applicable, a compliance officer (Oficial de Cumplimiento) designation, all consistent with Resolution 2023-03-31 issued by the Superintendency of Insurance and Reinsurance of Panama for any insurance-linked operations, and with the General Directorate of Financial Companies (Dirección General de Empresas Financieras) for licensed financial activities — though neither applies to the non-financial corporate vehicle in this pure trading dossier, the standards form the sectoral baseline for all resident agents acting as gatekeepers.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Sistema de Consulta de Nombres (Online Name Reservation and Consultation Portal via the 'Servicio en Línea' platform: www.registro-publico.gob.pa/consultas)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Panamanian corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or in a language using the Latin script. The name may include Latin-script English terms, but the principal corporate ending must be in Spanish: 'Sociedad Anónima' or its recognized abbreviation 'S.A.' The suffix may also appear as 'Sociedad Anónima de Capital Variable' (S.A. de C.V.) if desired, though fixed capital S.A. is more common. Transliteration is required for any non-Latin-script corporate name elements; the Director General del Registro Público may require a certified transliteration. The name must not be identical to nor confusingly similar to an existing registered Panamanian company, and must not contain terms that conflict with public order, morals, or banking secrecy statutes.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Banca, Financiera, Seguros, Reaseguros, Fondo de Inversión (require prior authorization by Superintendencia de Bancos and/or Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores)
Trust, Fideicomiso (require prior license from Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá)
Petróleo, Gas, Hidrocarburos (require prior approval by the Ministry of Energy or the National Secretariat of Energy, as applicable)
Exploración, Minera (require prior authorization by the Ministry of Commerce and Industries)
Canal de Panamá, Canal (restricted due to national patrimony protection and the Panama Canal Authority's exclusive jurisdiction)
Navegación, Naviera, Shipping, Marítima (restricted use; prior approval by the Panama Maritime Authority (AMP) required)
Reaseguros, Aseguradora, Clínica, Hospital, Farmacia (require health or insurance sector pre-clearance)
Cooperativa (requires prior approval by the National Institute of Cooperatives - INECOP)
Zona Libre, Colón Free Trade Zone (requires prior concession approval from the Zona Libre de Colón administration)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event that the Registro Público rejects a proposed corporate name (non-conformity, similarity, or prohibited token), the subscriber (promoter) has a statutory right to file a written appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same registry authority within five (5) business days of notification of the rejection, pursuant to Article 141 of the Registro Público Regulation and Administrative Procedure Law (Ley 38 de 2000). Should the registry maintain its rejection, the aggrieved party may elevate a hierarchical appeal (recurso de apelación) to the Director General del Registro Público within five (5) business days of the resolution. A twenty-five dollar (USD 25.00) filing fee applies per administrative appeal, payable via the official tax collection platform (Banco Nacional de Panamá or authorized paanama tax portal). If the name is rejected due to likeness, the petitioner may also propose two (2) alternate names during the appeal to expedite the resolution process.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a standard Sociedad Anónima used for international bulk export activities, provided that the company maintains a bona fide registered agent (Agente Residente) with a physical office address in Panama City or the Republic of Panama. The registered agent must be a licensed attorney or a licensed corporate service provider. The registered office address will be the same as the resident agent's office address. A virtual office (without physical occupancy in any Panamanian territory) is acceptable at the pre-incorporation and compliance stage, but the Board of Directors must ensure that operational substance (such as banking arrangements and decision-making) does not take place from a blacklisted or high-risk jurisdiction. For the import/export trading of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals, the commercial substance is evidenced through contracts, invoices, insurance, shipping documents, and retention of a Panamanian resident agent together with (recommended) maintenance of a local local bank account and the filing of annual franchise tax returns.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspections: 3% annually for a low-risk, non-licensed wholesale herbal export S.A., based on the established enforcement statistics of the UAF and the Revenue Directorate (DGI). The risk increases to 12% if the company maintains a Colombian peso heavy cash flow pattern, or 8% if the counterparties include the U.S./EU herbal wholesale market without adequate EDD. For fully compliant administrative-only structures, the physical inspection probability is estimated at 1% per year.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas), as amended; principal sections governing corporate formation, authorized share capital, registered office and registered agent, board of directors, officers, corporate books, and registry inscription, read together with the Regulations of the Registro Público de Panamá and residual mercantile provisions of the Código de Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil (Folio Electrónico), Dirección General del Registro Público
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Pacto Social / Articles of Incorporation), duly notarized before a Panamanian Notary Public and inscribed in the Mercantile Folio of the Registro Público de Panamá; the issuance of the Ficha Electrónica and Certificate of Incorporation evidences juristic personality.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement. The Articles of Incorporation may declare an authorized capital (customarily USD 10,000) divided into common shares of par or no-par value; shares may be subscribed and paid in cash, property, or services at the incorporators' discretion, and neither full payment nor a bank escrow is required at formation under Ley No. 32 de 1927.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That this Sociedad Anónima is duly incorporated and each subscriber hereby subscribes for and is allotted the common voting shares set beside his/her name, having validly tendered the full lawful consideration; That the registered office is established in Panama City, and [name of licensed firm] is appointed registered agent; That the following officers are elected until the next Annual General Meeting: President, Treasurer, and Corporation Secretary, each authorized to open corporate bank accounts, execute trade contracts, and procure all export licenses and permits; That the President shall file these resolutions with the Public Registry of Panama and shall cause the corporate books to be duly notarized and registered; and That these resolutions take effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas / Mercantil (single-window counter at the Public Registry headquarters, Panama City; online pre-submission via the registry portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the approved corporate name search and reservation form, listing proposed names in order of preference and each ending with 'Sociedad Anónima' (S.A.). Pay the statutory search fee and obtain the 'Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre' reserving the selected name for 30 calendar days. Confirm the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity and obtain pre-calification before proceeding to the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Completed corporate name search and reservation application form
Copy of applicant passport or corporate authorization for agents
Payment receipt for the corporate name search fee
List of proposed corporate names in order of preference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or conflict, file a reconsideration brief with the Registry or immediately file a new reservation with an alternative name; administrative recusal deadlines must be observed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial Execution of the Articles of Incorporation (Escritura Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Panama (competent notary of the First Judicial Circuit, Panama City)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the designated notary with the name reservation certificate and constituent documents. Execute the Escritura Pública de Constitución containing the corporate name; registered office address in Panama; general purpose including international bulk wholesale and export of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals; authorized share capital and share classes; duration; board structure; and appointment of the initial registered agent (resident licensed attorney or fiduciary services provider). The notary protocolizes the deed and issues certified first testimonios for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Corporate name reservation certificate
Draft Escritura Pública de Constitución (Articles of Incorporation)
Valid passports and/or corporate charters of all incorporators
Letters of acceptance from the registered agent and initial directors
Proof of payment of notarial fees and stamp taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial deficiencies are cured through a supplementary notarial amendment clause before the same notary; corrected testimonios are reissued and the superseded version remains archived in the notarial protocol.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Escritura in the Public Registry Mercantile Folio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil (Folio Electrónico)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the original certified first testimonio of the Escritura together with the mercantile registration application and proof of payment of the incorporation registration fee. The Registry qualifies the deed, assigns the corporate folio number (Ficha Electrónica), and returns the Certificate of Incorporation evidencing the company's legal existence. The registered agent must thereafter maintain the corporate expediente current for all post-incorporation filings.
required_dossiers: Certified first testimonio of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Mercantile registration application form
Corporate name reservation certificate
Receipt of payment of registry fees and national stamp duties
Identification and credentials of the presenting registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a 'prevención' (query or observed deficiency), the registered agent files an answering brief with corrected documentation within the statutory cure period; any adverse qualification may be challenged through the administrative appeal hierarchy of the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of the First Board Resolution and Filing of Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial Board of Directors of the Sociedad Anónima; Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil (for inscription of officer appointments)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene and hold the organizational meeting of the initial board and adopt the notarized Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, allotting the subscribed shares, fixing the registered office and registered agent, electing the President, Treasurer, and Corporation Secretary, and delegating authority to open bank accounts and pursue export licenses. File the list of directors and officers (Nómina de Directores), individual officer acceptances, and the certified share allotment schedule with the Public Registry for inscription in the corporate file.
required_dossiers: Notarized Pro-Forma First Board Resolution and minutes
Individual officer acceptance letters (Aceptación de Cargos)
Share subscription and allotment schedule
Nómina de Directores (director and officer roster form)
Registered agent's certified acceptance of appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficient or unsigned appointments are cured by resubmitting notarized signatures; non-resident directors and officers may execute through duly apostilled powers of attorney with certified Spanish translation, and the corrected roster is re-filed within the Registry's response window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening and Registration of Statutory Corporate Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of Panama (opening and protocolization); Registro Público de Panamá (registration and stamping of corporate books)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the three statutory corporate books — Minutes Book (Libro de Actas), Share Ledger (Libro de Acciones), and Shareholders Register (Libro de Registro de Accionistas) — to a notary for opening certification, folio numbering, and sealing. After notarization, file the books with the Public Registry for registration. Thereafter, maintain contemporaneous entries for all Board and shareholder resolutions, share transfers, and capital movements in accordance with Ley No. 32 de 1927 and Panamanian corporate records requirements.
required_dossiers: Statutory corporate books (minutes book, share ledger, shareholders register)
Certificate of Incorporation (Ficha Electrónica)
Board appointment of the book custodian
Payment receipt for book registration and stamp duties
Identity document and credential of the legalizing representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rejected books must be re-opened by the notary with corrected numbering and folios; historical entries are then ratified by a subsequent Board resolution so chronological continuity of the registers is preserved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (RUC/NIT) and Municipal Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (RUC/NIT online window); Municipality of Panama — Business License Department, with the Panama Chamber of Commerce acting as an authorized collection agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Certificate of Incorporation (Ficha Electrónica) and the registered Escritura, enroll the Sociedad Anónima in the Registro Único de Contribuyente through the DGI electronic portal and obtain the NIT (taxpayer identification number). Then file the Aviso de Operación with the Municipality of Panama for the ISIC 4631 activity (wholesale of dried agricultural products and botanicals), pay the proportional municipal operating tax, and obtain the signed operating receipt. If the company will issue invoices, complete the DGI electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) registration.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation / Ficha Electrónica
RUC and NIT registration forms (DGI)
Municipal zoning and land-use certificate for the warehouse address
Lease contract or ownership title of the registered operating premises
Identification documents of officers and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RUC assignment is delayed, follow the DGI checklist and request provisional tax registration; if the Aviso de Operación is issued with observations, file corrections within the municipal cure period, or appeal a municipal denial on zoning grounds before the competent municipal administrative board.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Dirección Nacional de Empresas Industriales y Comerciales and Dirección de Comercio Exterior (export registration window)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Operación / Aviso de Operación for ISIC 4631 (Wholesale of Agricultural Raw Materials — Dried Goji Berries and Herbal Botanicals) and Export Registration as an Exporter of Food-Grade Herbal Products

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Normas y Cumplimiento Ambiental, Unidad de Evaluación Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I — Low-Risk Environmental Registration (Registro Ambiental de Bajo Riesgo); the activity is commercial warehousing, inspection, and repacking of dried botanicals without industrial transformation, so a full Environmental Impact Study (EsIA) is not required. A simplified environmental registration statement and annual operating report must be filed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Panamanian effluent discharge standards under Decreto Ejecutivo No. 8 de 1995 and COPANIT norms: pH 6.0–9.0, BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L, TSS ≤ 150 mg/L for any wash-water discharges; zero-impact stormwater management and prohibition of ozone-depleting refrigerants in cold storage; fugitive dust and herbal particulate emissions from handling areas must remain below the occupational 8-hour threshold limit values established by Panamanian occupational health rules; dried botanical waste must be segregated and disposed through traceable municipal or authorized valorization channels.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate (Certificado de Seguridad Contra Incendios) from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; municipal structural load and electrical/gas inspection certification for the warehouse premises; and occupational health, hygiene, and workplace safety clearance from MITRADEL — Dirección de Salud Ocupacional pursuant to Decreto Ejecutivo No. 16 de 2012, covering ventilation, first-aid provisions, worker exposure controls for herbal dust, and documented staff safety training.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; taxpayer portal: Sede Electrónica de la DGI (Panama e-Tax system)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must maintain a resident agent in Panama and register with the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) before the DGI. The application is made through the Sede Electrónica portal using a power of attorney, executed articles of incorporation, and a pre-registration form. Upon approval, the DGI issues a Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) which serves as the definitive tax identification number for all domestic tax and ITBMS filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama has no check-the-box or federal entity classification election. Under Panamanian law, a Sociedad Anónima is always treated as a separate taxable corporation subject to territorial income tax on Panama-source income. Foreign tax law classifications are ignored by the DGI; a Panama S.A. cannot elect to be transparent for domestic purposes. No hybrid mismatch election is available under Panamanian tax legislation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) – Panamanian VAT-type transfer tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general de minimis turnover threshold. Registration for ITBMS is mandatory for all persons engaged in taxable activities, including importing goods into Panama, selling goods, or granting services for consideration. A foreign supplier that provides digital or offshore services to Panamanian resident customers is also required to register and pay ITBMS unless the service constitutes an exported service eligible for zero rating.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica) through the DGI's Sistema de Facturación Electrónica. Invoices must be digitally transmitted to the DGI in near-real-time, encrypted with a valid 'quiniela fiscal' (fiscal verification code), and cleared through authorized web-service APIs. Large taxpayers are subject to phased mandatory e-invoicing based on annual gross income thresholds; non-compliance results in invoice invalidity and administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Panama and international services are eligible for 0% ITBMS when the goods physically depart Panama within the statutory timeframe, title passes to a non-resident purchaser, or services are executed and exploited outside Panama. The exporter must retain a completed export declaration, the corresponding customs exit record, the contract of sale, and proof of payment from the foreign buyer. Failure to substantiate the export within the fiscal audit period causes the sale to be reclassed as taxable at 7%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUI/DEX under SIGA Panamá)
Inward Remittance Certificate (comprobante de ingreso de divisas)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI conducts substantive audits of zero-rated ITBMS export claims. If the export documents are absent, false, or incomplete, the 0% rate is annulled retroactively and the exporter must pay the deferred ITBMS together with inflation-adjusted interest. Administrative fines range from 100% to 300% of the evaded tax depending on the degree of fraud. Submission of falsified customs or banking export proof triggers criminal liability under Panama's tax procedure law and anti-money-laundering legislation for documentary fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama operates under a de facto full-dollarization regime with no central monetary authority. Banking, prudential supervision, and FX oversight are vested in the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) under Decree Law 2 of 2008, as amended; the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) oversees monetary policy coordination, and Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal agent of the Republic. Legal tender is the U.S. dollar; the balboa (PAB) exists solely as a unit of account and subsidiary coinage.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility applies to both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange controls, no surrender mandates, and no restrictions on inbound or outbound wire transfers. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders of a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima incur no withholding tax. The only frictions are documentary: SBP-due-diligence rules (Acuerdo 3/1997 as amended by Law 23/2015) and bank source-of-funds verification for trade-related receipts, which require underlying invoices, customs declarations, and shipping evidence. The financial system is U.S.-dollar native, effectively eliminating FX risk within Panama and enabling direct USD clearing via Federal Reserve correspondent accounts and SWIFT.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Export proceeds may be retained in foreign bank accounts at the exporter's discretion. However, all shipments of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals must be declared through the Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE) of the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) for customs and trade statistics; the bank will require the ANA export declaration, commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading to evidence the commercial nature of received funds and to satisfy SBP anti-money-laundering obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD tranches, trade financing, and liquidity)
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account (trade settlement and wholesale payments)
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account (corporate treasury and wire transfers)
Operational Account (state fiscal agent; slower onboarding)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for ancillary low-value flows; Low as a primary treasury rail. Offshore digital EMI accounts (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Airwallex) are not licensed banks under Decree Law 2 of 2008 and cannot issue Panamanian corporate IBANs, hold escrow balances, or originate Commercial Letters of Credit. The SBP's innovation hub regime (Acuerdo 007 of 2022) authorizes sandbox testing of payment and EMI-type services, but full statutory bank-guarantee and clearing privileges are not yet granted. The Panamanian S.A. should therefore designate a fully licensed SBP bank as the principal liquidity and clearing venue and use EMIs solely for collection of small receivables in foreign markets with immediate onward settlement to the SBP-bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical compliance interview is the de facto market standard. At least one director with signatory authority must appear before the bank's compliance officer or a designated notary-attorney for biometric verification and execution of signature cards. Remote onboarding is permitted only at the bank's absolute discretion, typically for low-risk, pre-vetted corporate groups where apostilled constitutional documents are presented and a secure video interview is conducted with the SBP-bank's AML officer. Under SBP Acuerdo 3/1997 and Law 23/2015, the final determination that customer identity has been reliably verified rests with the bank, so fully paperless onboarding lacks a statutory entitlement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed beneficial ownership or non-compliance with the Panama beneficial-ownership registry (Law 129 of 2020); ultimate beneficial owner appears only via bearer-share nominee.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official excerpt from the Registro Público de Panamá; notarized and apostilled shareholders' register with full UBO schedule; UBO sworn declaration under Law 129/2020; certified copy of the board resolution appointing the signatory director.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade counterparties domiciled in CFATF/FATF gray-listed or high-risk jurisdictions, raising sanctions screening flags on goji berry and herbal commodity flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Screen-approved counterparty KYC pack (certificate of incorporation, license, UBO disclosure); signed supply and purchase agreements; letters of origin from the People's Republic of China or alternative producer state; cargo documentation (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, phytosanitary certificate); sanctions-screening output from a recognized compliance system.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Herbal botanical wholesale without valid sanitary and export licensing from MINSA and MICI, creating reputational and regulatory exposure for the bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: MINSA sanitary registration certificate for food/botanical products (Resolución 0710/2021 and subsequent amendments); MICI commercial license; ANA exporter registration; HACCP or equivalent quality certification; batch-level Certificate of Analysis for dried goji berries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection inconsistent with the declared salary, savings, or business profile of the non-resident shareholder; unexplained high-net-worth inflow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds dossier comprising remitting bank statement (6 months), sale/purchase agreement or business exit contract, audited financial statements of the beneficial owner (or certified liquidation of assets), tax residency certificate from the shareholder's jurisdiction, and a notarized declaration of origin of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or high-tax-haven-resident beneficial owner with indirect ownership structure and no economic substance in Panama.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax residency certificate of each UBO; PEP enhanced due-diligence questionnaire; organizational chart evidencing the full ownership chain; evidence of substance in Panama (local registered agent agreement, visibly local director, corporate email/résumé); reference letter from a relationship bank in the UBO's country.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing requires a SWIFT MT103 denominated in USD from the non-resident shareholder's personal or corporate account to the S.A.'s operational USD account at an SBP-licensed bank. The wire reference must state 'Aporte de Capital / Capital Contribution — PA_CORP' and, when available, the corporate RUC number. The bank will require the apostilled incorporation excerpt (papeleta), the notarized shareholders' subscription resolution, and a source-of-funds banker's reference; no exchange-control approval is needed given full dollarization. Earmarked Capital Escrow Accounts may be separately opened to record the initial paid-in capital before activation of trade operations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements toward dried goji berry and herbal suppliers (principally P.R.C. and regional distributors) should use: (i) SWIFT MT103 for telegraphic transfers, typically structured as 30% prepayment with 70% against scanned shipping documents; (ii) irrevocable, at-sight Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 for consignments above USD 50,000, issued by the Panamanian bank and advised/confirmed by the beneficiary's bank; and (iii) documentary collection (D/P) for established counterparties. All disbursements must reconcile with the VUCE/ANA export declaration and the commercial invoice to preserve the low-risk AML classification and to support trade-finance eligibility.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (USD against EUR, GBP, CHF, JPY, and CNY) executed under ISDA 2002 with SBP-licensed bank counterparties
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing offshore CNY (CNH) and other restricted-currency crosses, settled in USD
Cross-currency swaps (USD/CNY and USD/EUR) for long-dated working-capital and procurement hedges, subject to bilateral credit support annex margin
Plain-vanilla FX options (calls and puts on USD crosses) permitted under board treasury authorization and SBP high-risk derivative governance
USD-liquidity swap lines with the bank's treasury desk under a 12-month rollover facility, employing no leverage

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Payment and DGI Tax Receipt ('Tasa Anual')
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before July 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a 10% surcharge plus monthly interest penalties; the company loses tax standing ('Paz y Salvo') and cannot obtain official certificates or registrations; continued non-payment for five consecutive years may lead to administrative strike-off by the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Income Tax Return ('Declaración Jurada de Renta')
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the close of the fiscal year; for a December 31 fiscal year-end, the return is due on or before March 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties escalate from approximately USD 50 to USD 2,000 depending on gross income; repeated non-compliance may trigger a mandatory audit, civil fines, and administrative dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficial Owner (UBO) Registry Confirmation and Shareholding Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Beneficial Owner Registry (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) administered by the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation filed within 30 days of the corporation's anniversary date; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update UBO information may result in administrative fines up to USD 20,000 per violation, suspension of corporate filing services, and potential administrative strike-off for persistent default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A mandatory independent audit applies in Panama where the S.A. has annual gross revenue exceeding USD 1,000,000, total assets equal to or greater than USD 750,000, or where the DGI or other competent authority expressly requires audited financial statements. A Panama S.A. with no Panama-source income and no local commercial activity is generally audit-exempt but must maintain financial records and unaudited statements available for inspection.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Panama's accounting authority; small- and medium-sized entities may apply the IFRS for SMEs framework; accounting records must be kept in Spanish or English and maintained in US Dollar/Balboa denominations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Panama's beneficial ownership rules, the registered agent must maintain a current record of all final beneficial owners and file an annual confirmation in the DGI Beneficial Owner Registry. Any transfer of shares must be reflected in the Register of Members and simultaneously reported to the Beneficial Owner Registry within 30 days of the transfer; a nil annual confirmation is still required if no ownership change has occurred.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members ('Registro de Accionistas') with share ledger
Minute Book of shareholder and board meetings ('Libro de Actas')

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $1,500 – $5,000 per year for a small- or mid-sized Panamanian S.A.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday applies to herbal wholesale exporters. The territorial regime yields an effective 0% rate on foreign-source export margins, while Panamanian-source income is taxed at 25%. Preferential deductions are limited to ordinary documented costs (COGS, freight, logistics, commissions); the Colon Free Zone (CFZ) regime and the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime under Law 45 of 2007 are available only to qualifying licensees and are not applicable to pure distribution income of a standard S.A.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 100 - Declaracion Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta (Personas Juridicas), filed through the DGI electronic portal Sistema E-Tax Panama (https://etax.dgi.gob.pa)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; advance income tax payments (pagos a cuenta) and the 4% dividend-reserve quota are declared quarterly via Form 102
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be e-filed within three months after the end of the fiscal period; for a calendar-year S.A., the statutory deadline is 31 March of the following fiscal year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC (Registro Unico de Contribuyentes) of the S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the RUC as certified by the DGI; non-resident shareholders must maintain a resident legal representative and a Panamanian registered agent.
State the exact 12-month period; for the standard calendar year, enter 01/01/YYYY to 12/31/YYYY. Alternative fiscal years require prior DGI approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panamanian-source gross income (rentas de fuente panamena)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all sales where delivery, use, exploitation, or consumption occurs in Panama; include domestic wholesale revenue and any local resale of dried goji berry products.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source gross income (rentas de fuente extranjera) - informational
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report export sales of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals delivered abroad under Incoterms EXW/FOB/CIF. This amount is excluded from the taxable base under the territorial regime but must be fully supported by bills of lading, purchase orders, and customs exit stamps.

Documented purchase cost of lycium botanicals, freight, warehousing, insurance, bank charges, and commissions. Deductions are disallowed if unsupported or linked to related-party transactions without transfer-pricing documentation.
Panamanian-source gross income less deductible expenses. Enter zero or a loss where the S.A. has only foreign-source export margins.
Multiply Box 6 by 25%. If Box 6 is zero, enter zero but still sign and e-file the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits: advance payments, withholding tax, and dividend reserve
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit the 4% quarterly pagos a cuenta, third-party retentions, and the dividend-reserve advance; attach payment receipts. Excess foreign VAT is not creditable.
Result of Box 7 less Box 8. Direct debit from a Panama bank account or pay via RUC-linked reference; no refund of minimal credit balances is automatic.
Mark the annex as filed only where related-party cross-border transactions exceed the PAB 2,000,000 documentation threshold or where the DGI has requested a TP study.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late e-filing subjects the S.A. to an administrative fine of up to PAB 10,000 and a 10% surcharge on unpaid tax for each overdue semester, capped at 50%; default interest accrues at 1% per month. The DGI may suspend the RUC and pursue collection through an executive judicial proceeding (juicio ejecutivo).
